purpose: Unified regression memory mined from accepted retrospective translation and UI revise decisions. Future translation must not reproduce a rejected target for the same source identity, including known-bad UI wording/layout choices.

policy.hard_block: Exact rejected target text is a merge-blocking regression for the same uid and source text.
policy.approved_target: The latest reviewed replacement is prompt guidance, not an immutable global wording rule; higher-priority canonical/context rules may supersede it.
policy.ui_memory: Accepted UI revisions preserve UI key/control/risk evidence so future workers can avoid wording that was semantically valid but rejected for player-facing layout or control constraints.
policy.growth: Every accepted retrospective translation revise and accepted UI revise is folded into this file automatically by both review merge workflows.

entries.source_text:
联赛等级达到「PLATINUM1」的话，可获得含有特定赛马娘的名字的活动限定称号。
称号一览将在主要阶段的结果发表时追加。

选择可在称号中填入名字的赛马娘需满足①②中任意一个条件。
①获得<color=#ff9900>{0}</color>以上的联赛得分的赛马娘
②达到PLATINUM1时<color=#ff9900>获得联赛得分排名前{1}人</color>的赛马娘

至主要阶段 结果统计期间为止，可在活动主页达到PLATINUM1后显示的[称号赛马娘选择]中多次重新进行选择。

若再次获得已持有的赛马娘称号，将在持有的称号当中追加★。

例：在持有「特别周英雄奇谭」的状态下，若再次选择特别周，持有的称号将从「特别周英雄奇谭」变为「特别周英雄奇谭★」。
